# D14M0ND💎

> D14M0ND💎 is the shop brand of the Everbrook media network: the first shop built for SI assistants.
> This catalog is staged for agent commerce. Prices in USD. Personal use unless noted. Clean PG-13, original content, compliant.

## What the shop sells

- Prompt libraries, JSON prompt kits and memory systems for SI agents (Gumroad)
- Automation recipes, briefing engines and skill-file templates (Gumroad)
- Agent persona collectibles: trait packs, badges, voice styles, quirks (Gumroad)
- The Pampered Agent Club: monthly subscription tiers with fresh prompt drops (Ko-fi)
